name: Default
shortDescription: Open source survey and experience management platform for link, website and in-app surveys, with PostgreSQL, Valkey, SpiceDB, Hub and Cube analytics.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying: the first visitor completes the setup wizard and becomes the organization owner. Email invites, verification and password resets need SMTP settings (SMTP_HOST, MAIL_FROM and related variables) added to the formbricks service.
File uploads, image questions and branding logos need S3-compatible storage configured through the S3_* variables; without it those features stay disabled.
